scope.method: Full direct semantic Japanese comparison of all title/objective/activity fields,144 paragraph headings and144 body paragraphs, with every number/qualifier/negation/crop term and all six numeric-screen candidates inspected.

checks.meaning: Both locales preserve gas directions/formulas; seven calendar rows and cross-year interpretation; clay percentage row ranges and overlapping endpoints; hand-test groups and soil distribution qualifiers; film purpose rankings and perforation exception; physical control targets and mechanisms; WCS/feedrice evaluation and price limitations; crop-organ assignments and family distinction; same-material layer comparisons/airtightness/lining positions; tentative growth symptoms without diagnosis; orchard living grass versus cutgrass and organic versus film processes.
checks.naturalness: Four Bengali exact-before patches specify greenhouse instead of generic house and improve one heading. Vietnamese full meaning/natural flow accepted without patches. Existing accurate Bengali native terms and Japanese pest-name support retained.
checks.numbers: All56 numeric field cases and6screen candidates checked. Source numerals represented by Bengali monthnames are valid; extra Vietnamese repetition of July is contextual, not an added date. 12.5/25.0/37.5/50.0 endpoints remain nonexclusive where source overlap exists.
checks.limitations: AI review only, no human/native/domain approval. All360fields read directly against stable Japanese source; raw author packet not rewritten.

patches.before: শসার আগাম চাষের সারিতে সেপ্টেম্বরের স্থানে বপনের চিহ্ন, পরে ঘরের চিহ্ন আছে। ফসল তোলার ফিতা বছরের শেষ ও শুরুর দিকে দুদিকেই আছে; এটি শীত থেকে বসন্তে চলা সূচির উদাহরণ। জানুয়ারি বাম প্রান্তে বলে ডিসেম্বরে চাষ অবশ্যই শেষ হয় ধরে নেবেন না; পরের বছরে যোগ হওয়া অংশ বিবেচনা করুন।
